tradition.name: Rap cristão
tradition.lineage: Brazilian Christian rap represented by the Greater Florianópolis gospel-rap practice documented in fieldwork.

extras.description: Faith-centered rhythmic verses are carried by electronic backing and DJ playback. The ethnography documents gospel events and MC/electronic-base roles, including situations where groups share DJ equipment. This selects a studio realization of that local practice, not an assumption that Christian rap universally has a choir or organ.

entries.geo_rationale: Representative documented practice or recording center for this branch; not an exclusive origin.

Twelve-tone studio reference and chain are authored convenience choices, not a claim about indigenous intonation.
